name: @proworks-hub/budgetiq
description: BudgetIQ — budget envelopes with encumbrance accounting: released-not-authorized consumable base, a nullable availability figure that cannot silently read an unknown channel as zero, commitment lifecycle with over-liquidation recorded rather than absorbed, exact-sum allocation and phasing, and carry-forward as an approvable derivation — never an edit.
author: Steven Kreutzer
